headline: PM chairs meeting on Dhaka's public transport management
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman led a high-level discussion to address chaos and improve road safety in the capital's transport system.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman chaired a high-level meeting on Thursday morning to discuss the management of public transport in Dhaka.
The meeting, held at the Cabinet Division of the Secretariat, focused on resolving existing chaos in the city's transport system and ensuring road safety.
Key officials in attendance included Road Transport and Bridges Minister Sheikh Rabiul Alam and LGRD State Minister Mir Shahe Alam.
Other participants included State Minister for Road Transport and Bridges Habibur Rashid and Dhaka Metropolitan Police Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed.
caption:
Dhaka's transport chaos under the lens. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman chairs a high-level meeting to fix the capital's public transport system.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman chaired a high-level meeting on Thursday morning to discuss the management of public transport in Dhaka.

The meeting, held at the Cabinet Division of the Secretariat, focused on resolving existing chaos in the city's transport system and ensuring road safety.

Key officials in attendance included Road Transport and Bridges Minister Sheikh Rabiul Alam and LGRD State Minister Mir Shahe Alam.

Other participants included State Minister for Road Transport and Bridges Habibur Rashid and Dhaka Metropolitan Police Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed.

headline_marked: [[Two RMG workers killed]] in Chattogram EPZ after pick-up van hits motorcycle
headline: Two RMG workers killed in Chattogram EPZ after pick-up van hits motorcycle
summary: A speeding pick-up van collided with a motorcycle in Chattogram's Export Processing Zone this morning, resulting in the deaths of two ready-made garment workers. The victims were pronounced dead at Chattogram Medical College Hospital.
details: Two ready-made garment workers were killed this morning when a speeding pick-up van hit their motorcycle in the Export Processing Zone (EPZ) area of Chattogram city. The victims were identified as Tamanna and Md Khalil.

The incident occurred around 9:00 AM on road no 5 in the EPZ area. Police and local sources reported that the two were travelling on a motorcycle when the pick-up van struck them, causing critical injuries.

Pedestrians brought the injured to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH), where duty doctors pronounced them dead. The bodies have been sent to the CMCH morgue for autopsies, according to Inspector Nurul Alam, in-charge of the CMCH police outpost.
